decks.notes: The deck focuses on utilizing Underworld Breach as a powerful combo enabler, allowing the player to continuously cast spells from their graveyard. It includes powerful cards such as Black Lotus, Ancestral Recall, and Bolas's Citadel to create explosive plays, while also running a suite of protection spells like Force of Will and Pyroblast. The deck aims to quickly assemble the necessary pieces for its combo and overwhelm the opponent with a combination of card advantage, mana acceleration, and disruptive plays.

The focus of this deck is on controlling the game through the use of powerful planeswalkers and disruption spells. By using cards like Dack Fayden, Narset, Parter of Veils, and Oko, Thief of Crowns, the deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent's threats. Utilizing cards like Force of Will, Spell Pierce, and Pyroblast, the deck can also disrupt the opponent's game plan and protect its own planeswalkers. Additionally, the deck includes powerful mana accelerants and card draw spells to ensure it can consistently hit its land drops and find key cards to control the game.

This deck focuses on disrupting opponents' strategies with disruptive cards such as Collector Ouphe and Deathrite Shaman, while also applying pressure with efficient creatures like Leovold, Emissary of Trest and Oko, Thief of Crowns. The deck also includes a variety of powerful spells like Force of Will and Abrupt Decay to deal with various threats. With access to powerful mana acceleration through Moxen and powerful card draw with Ancestral Recall and Brainstorm, this deck aims to control the game early and maintain a midrange advantage throughout the match.

This deck focuses on disrupting opponent's plays while deploying aggressive creatures to pressure them. It utilizes hatebears to slow down and hinder opponent's strategies, while also using aggro tactics to win the game quickly. The deck includes powerful mana artifacts to ramp up quickly, along with disruptive spells like Chalice of the Void and Swords to Plowshares. The goal is to control the game tempo by limiting opponent's options and overwhelming them with efficient creatures.

This aggro deck focuses on utilizing Bazaar of Baghdad and various discard outlets to quickly dump creatures like Hollow One, Master of Death, and Vengevine into the graveyard. With a combination of disruptive counter spells like Force of Will and Force of Negation, along with removal options like Force of Vigor and Wasteland, this deck aims to maintain pressure on opponents while disrupting their game plan. The graveyard recursion provided by Noxious Revival and Squee, Goblin Nabob allows for consistent threats to be constantly reanimated and put on the battlefield.

The deck aims to quickly assemble a powerful board state using artifacts like Mishra's Workshop, Mana Vault, and Grim Monolith, while generating card advantage with Coveted Jewel and Paradoxical Outcome. It also utilizes Time Vault and Voltaic Key combo for an extra turn win condition. The deck has a strong control element with cards like Force of Will and Sink into Stupor to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Ultimately, the deck's strategy revolves around generating mana and card advantage through artifacts to win the game with powerful combo interactions.

The main concept of this Vintage 1 vs 1 Dredge combo deck is to utilize cards like Bazaar of Baghdad, Serum Powder, and Golgari Grave-Troll to quickly fill the graveyard with creatures like Ichorid, Narcomoeba, and Prized Amalgam. By dredging through the deck and using cards like Creeping Chill and Silversmote Ghoul to gain life and create additional threats, the goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a constant stream of creatures and disruptive spells like Force of Will and Chalice of the Void to protect the combo.

The deck focuses on utilizing the powerful card draw and mana acceleration of Paradoxical Outcome to generate a large amount of card advantage and mana to execute combos quickly. The deck includes multiple powerful mana rocks like Black Lotus and Moxen to ramp up mana production, along with cards like Time Vault and Tolarian Academy to take advantage of this mana. Additionally, the deck includes disruption and protection spells like Force of Will and Swords to Plowshares to control the game until it can assemble its combo pieces and win the game.

This deck aims to quickly generate card advantage and mana through a combination of artifacts and spells, leading to a powerful combo win condition with Paradoxical Outcome. By controlling the board with counterspells and removal like Force of Will and Swords to Plowshares, the deck can set up its combo pieces like Time Vault and Mana Crypt to secure victory. The deck is designed to be efficient and versatile, adapting to different scenarios while maintaining a strong focus on assembling the combo for a game-winning play.

The deck focuses on denying the opponent's resources and controlling the game through counterspells, removal, and hand disruption. It utilizes powerful spells like Ancestral Recall and Time Walk to gain card advantage and tempo. The inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion allows for additional value from the graveyard. The combination of disruptive creatures like Lavinia and Psychic Frog with efficient removal spells like Swords to Plowshares creates a strong control shell. Overall, the deck aims to manipulate the game in its favor and outvalue the opponent.

This deck utilizes a combination of disruptive spells, powerful creatures, and efficient removal to control the game and apply pressure to the opponent. By leveraging cards like Force of Will, Oko, Thief of Crowns, and Deathrite Shaman, it seeks to disrupt the opponent's game plan while building its own board presence. With a mix of countermagic, creature removal, and card advantage, this deck can adapt to various strategies and outmaneuver the opponent to secure victory.

This deck focuses on quickly filling up the graveyard with cards like Stinkweed Imp, Golgari Thug, and Creeping Chill, using Bazaar of Baghdad to facilitate this process. Once the graveyard is full, the deck utilizes cards like Narcomoeba and Prized Amalgam to bring back creatures and create a powerful board presence. Noxious Revival and Force of Will help protect the combo pieces, while Shambling Shell and Hollow One provide additional ways to fill the graveyard. Force of Negation and Grief disrupt opponent's strategies, allowing the deck to execute its game plan effectively.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly reanimate powerful creatures like Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Archon of Cruelty using cards like Reanimate and Entomb. The deck includes a mix of disruption cards like Force of Will and removal spells like Fatal Push to protect the combo pieces and clear the way for the reanimated creatures to take over the game. The deck also includes card draw and library manipulation spells like Brainstorm and Ponder to help find the combo pieces quickly and efficiently.

The main focus of this deck is on utilizing graveyard interactions and dredge mechanics to quickly fill the graveyard with key creatures like Narcomoeba and Prized Amalgam. Using cards like Noxious Revival and Creeping Chill to leverage this strategy, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of creatures like Ichorid and Hollow One. With a strong backup plan of countermagic like Force of Will and Force of Negation, this combo-driven deck is designed to disrupt opponents while executing its game plan efficiently.

This deck focuses on utilizing the Paradoxical Outcome card to generate a large amount of mana and card advantage through the use of artifacts. It aims to set up a combo using cards like Time Vault and Manifold Key to take extra turns, while also controlling the game with counterspells and removal like Force of Will and Swords to Plowshares. The deck includes key pieces like Moxen, Tolarian Academy, and Urza's Saga to ramp up quickly and establish a dominating board presence. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with powerful plays and win through a combo finish.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game by disrupting the opponent's strategy while leveraging powerful cards like Ancestral Recall, Force of Will, and Demonic Tutor to maintain card advantage and control the board. The inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion provides additional value and recursion options. The deck is designed to outmaneuver opponents through efficient spell interaction and disruption spells, while also having the flexibility to adapt to various situations with a versatile card pool.
